Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to cyclically rotate an array by a given number of positions. Given an array of integers and a number k, rotate the array to the right by k positions. The rotation should be cyclic, meaning that elements that go past the end of the array come back to the start. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an integer n (size of the array).
The second line contains n integers separated by spaces (elements of the array).
The third line contains an integer k (number of positions to rotate). 
Output Description:
Print the array after cyclic rotation. 
Sample Input:
5
1 2 3 4 5
2 
Sample Output:
4 5 1 2 3
